If placement does complete using Moon Harvest, immediately lose 2 Soul and mark use consumed; if this reduces Soul from 2 to 0, the game ends immediately under D221. A legal election still requires Moon Harvest unused this Round and Artemis having at least 2 Soul at the election checkpoint (D221–D222). If the Base is successfully placed while that waiver was elected, the once-each-Round Moon Harvest opportunity is consumed and Artemis loses 2 Soul immediately after placement, regardless of whether the waiver was necessary. With exactly 2 Soul, this produces immediate match loss (D221). Without election, the normal legal placement neither consumes Moon Harvest nor loses Soul. If a legally elected placement does not complete, neither the use nor the 2 Soul is consumed (D257). No extra placement permission is granted, no other legality restriction is overridden, and the bypass does not persist to any later attempt. This ruling does not decide absent/no printed Cosmoble requirements.
sequence: Begin an otherwise legal opportunity to place a card as a Cosmo Base; this ruling does not create a new opportunity or extra action.

The triggering event and the Controller-at-Seal Mill 2 snapshot from D265 are already registered; they do not require the affected Devotee to remain on the Battlefield, to remain under the original controller, or to remain Sealed until resolution. When the trigger resolves while the game is still in progress, the D265 recorded player attempts Mill 2, applying D233 to missing deck cards, and Poseidon independently attempts Draw 1 per D234. If the departed card returns, it is a new Battlefield object; the old trigger remains tied to its recorded first-Seal event and never retroactively Seals, moves or grants effects to the new object. This decision grants no zone movement, no new trigger, no new targeting, no change to a separately existing game-ending state and no new priority window.

D267.scope: ONLY number and independent identity of triggered abilities when multiple distinct enemy Devotees become Sealed in the same simultaneous event.
D267.original_text_exact_unchanged: Whenever an enemy Devotee becomes Sealed, its controller mills two cards and you draw a card.
D267.d198_current_text_exact_unchanged: Whenever an enemy Devotee becomes Sealed, its controller mills two cards and you draw a card.
D267.canonical: For each distinct enemy Devotee whose Seal-marker count effectively transitions from zero to at least one in a simultaneous legally existing Seal event, and while Pressure of the Deep is eligible to trigger, create ONE distinct Pressure of the Deep triggered ability. Neither the number of markers placed on the same Devotee nor grouping multiple Devotees into one simultaneous effect changes this one-trigger-per-qualifying-Devotee count. Every generated trigger separately records the Controller of its own affected Devotee at that Seal event for Mill 2 (D265). At its later LIFO resolution, while the game continues, that recorded player attempts Mill 2 (D233) and Poseidon independently attempts Draw 1 (D234). If the affected Devotee changes controller or exits Battlefield, the already generated trigger remains under D265 and D266. The simultaneous application of Seal does not itself create an intervening priority window. Existing APNAP/LIFO and victory/draw checks determine placement/order and whether each pending trigger subsequently resolves. No new source of Seal is created by this ruling.

D268.scope: ONLY consumption of once each round usage when optional Water Prison payment is declined, versus a legal optional payment for Seal attempted.
D268.original_text_exact_unchanged: Once each round, when an enemy Devotee declares a Strike, you may pay 2 Cosmo. If you do, Seal that Devotee.
D268.d198_current_text_exact_unchanged: Once each round, when an enemy Devotee declares a Strike, you may pay 2 Latent Cosmo. If you do, Seal that Devotee.
D268.canonical: A legal declaration of a Strike by an enemy Devotee generates the pre-existing Water Prison opportunity. If Poseidon DECLINES the optional 2 Latent Cosmo payment, he applies no Seal, loses no Latent, and DOES NOT consume the ability once-each-round use. If another legal enemy Devotee declares a Strike in the same Round while the use remains unused, the existing conditions may permit another opportunity. If Poseidon LEGALLY PAYS the optional 2 Latent Cosmo cost for the effect, the use is consumed at that election even if an already-legal prevention or replacement stops the proposed Seal from taking effect. The actual Seal transition and possible Pressure of the Deep trigger must still be independently assessed under D211, D264-D267; no Seal applied means no new Pressure trigger. No cost is paid if the player declines; no new legal timing windows, sources of Latent, changes to Seal, or repeat Strikes are created. The legal prior Strike is not canceled by later Seal (D212); control-change checks are per D263. Illegal proposed payment is rejected under existing payment legality, not a new ruling regarding failed payments.
